resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 1926 (firelookout.com) is the first cabin on the site; the 1965 date the register gives is the current R-6 cab. Both sources describe the same site and sequence of buildings.

notes_for_editor: Disputed: the register dates a gable-roofed L-4 ground cab to 1926, while firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date a cabin to 1926 and the L-4 cab to 1930; not resolved. Elevation is 7,461 ft in the register and firelookout.com but 7,641 on Idaho Fire Lookouts (may be a typo; not explained by any source). The record's location differs from Idaho Fire Lookouts by about 580 m; not checked here. Nothing read says whether visitors may enter the cab. The trip report is from 2013 and the road and trail details may be out of date. The 2021 staffing as_of comes from the June 9, 2021 Idaho Fire Lookouts article; the Keeping Watch page is undated. The Forest Service page in the tower's links (fs.fed.us, Nez Perce-Clearwater) did not resolve. A web search snippet mentioned a 2012 volunteer program start and a 2013 Forest Service description; neither was read, so neither is cited. Recommend checking current volunteer staffing and trail conditions with the Powell Ranger District before publishing.
